people.name: Ai
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day.
translations.bsb: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a permanent heap of ruins, a desolation to this day.
translations.kjv: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.
translations.asv: So Joshua burnt Ai, and made it a heap for ever, even a desolation, unto this day.
